Are the files consistent?

Source: R/model.R
vp_check.Rd

Check that the files are consistent: the properties that the graphs of any model must have. A FALSE means that the files are incomplete or were damaged (for example, filtered by hand in one graph and not in the other).

Usage

vp_check(model)

Arguments

model

A model, from vp_generate() or vp_read(), in its complete or its minimal form.

Value

A tibble with one row per property: property, holds (TRUE/FALSE) and violations (how many cases break it).

See also

Other whole model: vp_degree_distribution(), vp_gini(), vp_summary()

Examples

band <- vp_generate(vp_example("miband3.uvl"), or_graph = TRUE)
vp_check(band)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 3
#>   property                                                      holds violations
#>   <chr>                                                         <lgl>      <int>
#> 1 requires is complete: A -> B and B -> C give A -> C           TRUE           0
#> 2 conflicts are inherited: A -> B and B excludes C give A excl… TRUE           0
#> 3 no feature requires two features that exclude each other      TRUE           0
#> 4 no pair both requires and excludes                            TRUE           0
#> 5 at-least-one is inherited upwards: A or B, and B -> C give A… TRUE           0
#> 6 A excludes B and (B or C) give A -> C                         TRUE           0
